extDesc.message: Quick access to your favorite local LLM from your browser (Ollama).

settingsDesc.message: Racomi (Ollama WebUI) is a Chrome extension that provides quick access to your favorite local Language Model (LLM) directly from your browser. With features like open-source chat integration, mail reply suggestions, and more, it's designed to enhance your browsing experience with AI capabilities.

feature1.message: Open Side Panel: Access your LLM with a side panel using Ctrl+Shift+Left (or Command+Shift+Left on macOS).

feature2.message: Contextual Interaction: Select and interact with parts of websites for enhanced browsing.

feature3.message: Email Integration: Compose and reply to emails with AI-generated suggestions in Gmail.

feature4.message: Google Search Enhancements: Improved interaction with search results using marked.js and Prism.js.

feature5.message: Local LLM Integration: Communicates with a local instance of Ollama for AI responses.

chatInterfaceDesc.message: The Chat Interface is a key feature of Racomi, enabling seamless interaction with Ollama LLMs directly from your browser.

chatFeature1.message: Chat with Ollama LLMs: Interact with local language models for insightful responses and suggestions.

chatFeature2.message: Contextual Website Chat: Engage in conversations about the content of the current webpage.

chatFeature3.message: Customizable Prompts: Generate replies and posts based on selected text or specific prompts.

chatFeature4.message: Integration with Multiple Platforms: Use within Gmail, Google Search.

enableEmailDesc.message: Turn on this feature to Enhance your Gmail experience by enabling AI-generated suggestions for composing and replying to emails.

enableGoogleSearchDesc.message: Turn on this feature to improve your experience with search results.

noteLLM.message: Note: The responses generated are entirely dependent on the language model (LLM) that you are using.

suggestCoding.message: Explain how to write a Python function.

suggestEmail.message: Draft a professional job application email.

suggestSearch.message: Provide tips for effective web searches.

suggestWebchat.message: Chat with this webpage now (Not RAG)

aiWarning.message: LLMs can make mistakes. Verify important information.

unableToRead.message: Unable to read webpage. Please reload the page and try again.

restrictedPage.message: Cannot access browser internal pages or Web Store.

noTextFound.message: No text content found on this page.
